层次与深度
Glass
深度通过玻璃、边框对比以及可复用的阴影或模糊处理来传达。请在主视觉面板、卡片与控件间保持这些配方一致，使页面读起来像同一套材质体系。
表面应优先呈现玻璃质感，边框、阴影与模糊仅用于强化这一材质选择。
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 0px padding and a 28px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(rgb(11, 11, 13), rgb(11, 11, 13)), linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 42%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 100%) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• 间距需对齐检测到的 4px 节奏。
• 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。
• keep corner radii within the detected 16px, 24px, 28px, 32px, 40px, 9999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 不要exceed the detected expressive motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效偏表现型，但仍聚焦界面、文字与布局过渡。 时序主要聚集在 550ms 与 700ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 悬停行为侧重 Text 与 描边 变化。

WebGL
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a inset 3d accent using webgl, renderer, alpha, antialias, DPR 限制. The effect should read as retro-futurist, technical, and meditative: perspective grid field with green on black and sparse spacing. Build it from grid lines + depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve dom fallback.

三维引擎
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the 三维引擎 layer as a inset 3d accent 与层叠空间纵深 that feels retro-futurist, volumetric, and technical. Use alpha, antialias, DPR 限制 renderer settings, perspective, ~45deg fov, sphere + custom buffer geometry geometry, pointsmaterial + meshbasicmaterial materials, and 环境光 + 主光 + 轮廓光 lighting. Motion should read as slow orbital drift, with poster frame + dom fallback.
